Particle Size Distribution (PSD)

Hi everyone, 

I have been figuring out how to do this with Cheetah3D for a while and wanted to share with you this very simple script that allows for the generation of a particle system with a given particle size distribution (PSD). It is a macro script, so you first need to create the particle system (either particle array or particle emitter will do just fine) and then apply the script to set the scale of each particle according to the desired PSD. The script also outputs the positions and the radii of each particle (to the console and optionally to a file).

Please let me know any comment you have about it, I am still playing with it. Thanks!

Rodrigo

PD: in order to obtain the same images that I attached, you can just set the frame number to 60 (time=2s).

Attachments: [PSD.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/20264/)
